description: register_mail_handlers accepts a generic C (caller context) but ClosureHandler::call discards it with _caller. The README/lib.rs doc warns about this, but the warning is only in a Rust doc comment that most consumers won't read carefully. Any consumer who passes a per-request auth token in C and assumes it reaches the handler will silently not get auth enforcement. This is a public API invariant that fossilizes the moment consumers depend on register_mail_handlers. The consequence of getting it wrong is an authentication bypass.
title: caller context C silently dropped — no compile-time indication that auth is not forwarded
